notes.title: Day 1 Patch!
notes.content:
[b]Polarities v. 1.02[/b]
Thanks to everyone who have already bought and played our game! We understand that there were some problems at launch and we will try our best to fix those as we get reports of them! So please enjoy this day 1 patch!!

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
* Fixed a bug where the player would remain small after losing a life.
* Fixed a bug on the pause menu where the player was able to select something outside of the menu
* Fixed a issue where the player would spawn in in a different size during a new game.
* Fixed a bug where sometimes the player would walk left, but be faced right
